claim: Malaysia's ten conditions for a private agency, as published by the Ministry in October 2025, are at least five years of satisfactory operation since licensing; proof of sending at least 3,000 workers abroad in the last five years; experience in at least three destination countries in that time; valid licences from all relevant Bangladeshi authorities; a good-conduct certificate from the sending country's authority; no record of forced labour, trafficking, labour-law breaches, extortion, money laundering or other financial crime; its own training and assessment centre with accommodation; testimonials from five different foreign employers; a permanent office of at least 10,000 square feet run for at least three years; and proof of lawfully following destination countries' (including Malaysia's) recruitment conditions.
why_new: The conditions themselves are not in the guide; they explain why few agencies qualify.
